summary: Backend-only testing for PrepAlign Admin Dashboard endpoints. All 24 pytest cases PASSED (100%). Aggregation includes empty-string utm_source ({"$ne": None}) — consider also excluding empty strings to avoid blank source buckets.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py require_admin: correctly raises 401 then 403 (HTTPException propagates through FastAPI dependency correctly).
server.py _admin_email_set: lowercases + strips + filters empty — robust against whitespace/casing. Good.
server.py /api/auth/me: now returns is_admin flag — frontend can hide /admin link for non-admins. Good.
server.py /api/admin/stats: uses $match on utm_source with {$ne: None, $exists: true} — empty strings '' will still match. Consider adding {$ne: ''}.
server.py: admin list endpoints cap results at 2000 via to_list(2000). Fine for MVP, but no pagination — will silently truncate at scale.
server.py: no rate limiting on public POST endpoints (/webinar/register, /mentorship/request) — still vulnerable to spam. Out of scope for this iteration but worth tracking.
server.py created_at inconsistency across collections (ISO string vs datetime) persists — not a blocker.
